role_in_set: The one personal income tax levied by the Union itself: the tax for the benefit of the Union on the salaries, wages and emoluments of its officials and other servants, the persons liable (Art 2), the taxable amount and deductions (Art 3), the progressive rates (Art 4) and withholding at source. It touches only Union staff and certain former staff; it is in the set because it is the only binding EU law that taxes an individual's income directly.
